About this item

  • 10W Wireless Charging and USB Charging: The upgraded dimmable desk lamp has 10W fast wireless charging and USB charging functions. You can charge your mobile phone while working, studying, reading, crafting, and sleeping. Already included the 10V/2A 20W adapter plug
  • 50 Lighting Choices and Touch Control: 5 lighting modes X 10 levels of brightness, there are 50 lighting options in total. Using touch control technology, a suitable light can be selected easily and quickly
  • Eye Protection: Eye care diffused non-flickering Lighting. With 60 full-spectrum led beads and afrosted shade, it cast a brighter and broader span of soft light, which efficiently reduces eye fatigue
  • Foldable Design and Timing Function: This LED desk lamp has a 225° flexible arm and a 160° bottom axis. The foldable design makes it easy to carry and place. The 30/60 minutes Auto-timer, making sleep more comfortable, no need to worry about turning off
  • Long Lifespan and Energy-Efficient: The LED desk lamp has a lifespan of up to 60,000 hours, saving 65% energy compared to traditional incandescent bulbs. No UV or IR Radiation

Product description

Efficient & Energy saving

Using advanced ST technology, the lamp is 75% energy-saving than ordinary led lamps, and its service life is greatly extended. Multi-mode dimming, a total of 50 lighting modes can be combined, which is suitable for various environments.

Larger Lighting Coverage

60 High-Quality LED Bulbs (30 warm light & 30 cold light ), providing larger lighting coverage, giving you more comfortable reading or working experience.

Smart Memory Function

Keep the power connected, it can remember the brightness and lighting mode which you last set, you do not need to readjust it when you turn it on next time.

Packing List:

  • 1* LED Desk Lamp
  • 1* 10V/2A Adapter Plug
  • 1* User manual
  • 1* Package box

10W Fast Wireless Charging

Compared with the same type of products that only output 5W wireless charging power, JOSTIC upgrades 10W wireless charging power to charge faster. With a 10V/2A adapter, it is more efficient and stable.

30/60 Min Auto Timer

Green-light indicates the light will automatically turn off in 30 minutes;

Blue-light indicates the light will automatically turn off in 60 minutes.

USB Charger Port & Non-Slip

The non-slip bottom makes the lamp more stable, and the additional USB charging port can charge your mobile phone, iPad, and other devices, which is very convenient.

Flexible Design

Benefit from a flexible design, this desk lamp is easy to adjust and able to provide the best lighting angle, easy to place, and carry.
